Lakeview Homestay

3-star comfort and warm hospitality in the heart of the old city.

About the homestay

Lakeview Homestay is a family-run guest house on the banks of Lake Pichola. Our rooms look over the water and the hills beyond, and every morning starts with a home-cooked breakfast served on the rooftop terrace. We are a five-minute walk from the City Palace.

Rooms & Suites

Deluxe Lake View Room

Air-conditioned room with a double bed, attached bath and a window onto the lake.

Starting from ₹3,500 per night

Family Suite

Two connected rooms for up to five guests, with a small sitting area.

From ₹6,000 per night plus taxes

Rooftop Dormitory

Six beds, shared bathroom.

₹800 per person per night
